title: Сплетни (Трансформация в 3-е лицо)
description: Перескажи факты о друге (He/She...): преврати предложения от I в рассказ о нём.

items.sentence: I don't like waking up early. → He ___.
I spend all my pocket money on snacks. → He ___.
items.answer: spends all his pocket money on snacks

items.sentence: I don't do my homework on Fridays. → ___.
items.answer: He doesn't do his homework on Fridays

items.sentence: I chat with my friends online. → ___.
items.answer: He chats with his friends online

items.sentence: I dream of becoming a blogger. → ___.
items.answer: He dreams of becoming a blogger
